caption: The drawing is circular and rendered in shades of black, white, and gray. The central focus is a waterfront scene featuring several sailing ships with visible masts and rigging, located towards the left and center of the composition. To the right, there is a large multi-story building with small windows and a staircase leading down towards the water. In front of the building, there are smaller architectural elements, and an unnaturally tall flagpole flying a flag. The foreground shows a row of cannons with visible wheels and cannonballs nearby, aimed outward toward the water. Waves or stylized lines suggest movement in the water, while clouds occupy the upper portion of the image, contributing to a sense of depth. At the very bottom, along the edge, partially visible text reads "NDING E PEN LANE" which appears to be part of a longer inscription. The overall image is bordered by the round outline of the plate or medallion it is drawn on.
title: Cup Plate - "Castle Garden"
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
